Man Jailed for Life for Brutally Stabbing Wife 77 Times

A husband has been sentenced to life imprisonment for the murder of his wife, whom he stabbed 77 times. The man confessed to police, stating he had 'disposed' of his wife after the attack. The brutal nature of the crime, involving a high number of stab wounds, was highlighted in the proceedings. He received a life sentence for the offense.
